for: Quarterdeck merge build tests, design-spec.md sections 4.3, 4.4, 4.5, 4.7, 12
author: the content lead
rules: Test-only: loaded only by the build's test mode, never in the example data, never in anything shown to the Captain as example content.
Each fixture is one taskCards entry in the example data's shape, on an existing Lane; Page, Artifact and Mail refs point at existing example records.
In test mode the Queue and Lane counts include the loaded fixtures.

fixtures.fixture: F-1 one-way pick with real risk
expect: Above the pick, a red-edged block: '! One-way change: cannot be undone', then 'Risk: ' and option A's risk text (spec 4.4).
The pick's own lines skip Risk and the undo line.
Send A asks once: 'Send A? This cannot be undone.' with [ Confirm: send A ] and [ Back ]; a double tap sends once (4.5).
Choosing B (two-way) sends in one tap.

card.title: Delete the three old bridge rooms now?
card.about: After the move the three old bridge rooms sit empty. Deleting them removes their message history for good.
card.context:
Every message was copied to the new rooms on Nov 2.
The old rooms still show in the room list and confuse people.
card.ascii:
Old bridge rooms after the move
 ------------------------------------------
 old-room-1   empty   history 1,204 msgs
 old-room-2   empty   history   311 msgs
 old-room-3   empty   history    87 msgs
 A deletes all three and their history.
 The copies stay in the new rooms.

options.label: A. Delete all three now
options.does: Deletes the three old rooms and their history.
options.risk: Their message history is gone for good. If the copy missed a message, nobody can read it again.
pros: The room list shows only live rooms.

options.label: B. Keep them read-only for 30 days
options.does: Locks the rooms and hides them from the room list.
options.risk: They take a little space for a month.

card.pick_why: The copies were checked on Nov 2, and the empty rooms keep confusing people.
card.skip: If no answer by due: we keep them read-only and ask again Friday.

fixtures.fixture: F-2 two-way pick, one-way other option
expect: Option B's details (opened with its arrow) show its undo line 'Cannot be undone.' in red.
Send A sends in one tap; choosing B makes Send ask the confirm (4.5).

card.title: How should we clear space on the export disk?
card.about: The export disk is 92 percent full. Old export files can move to the archive disk or be deleted.
card.context:
Each export writes one file.
Files older than 90 days are almost never opened.
card.ascii:
Export disk
 ------------------------------------------
 [################################----] 92%
 Exports older than 90 days: 41 GB
 A. move them to the archive disk
 B. delete them

options.label: A. Move old exports to the archive disk
options.does: Moves files older than 90 days to the archive disk.
options.risk: The archive disk fills a little faster.

options.label: B. Delete exports older than 90 days
options.risk: An old export is gone for good; a past report can no longer be checked.

card.pick_why: Moving frees the same space and keeps every file.
card.skip: If no answer by due: we move them, as in A.

expect: type is 'high-risk approval', yet no block and no confirm: the label alone changes nothing.
Send A sends in one tap.

card.title: Turn on the new mail sync for every bot?
card.about: The new mail sync replaces the old one for all five bots at once.
card.context:
It ran for a day on Dale's mailbox with no errors.
If it fails, bots get no mail until it is turned off.
card.ascii:
Mail sync, all five bots
 ------------------------------------------
 Iris       old sync  ->  new sync
 Alba    old sync  ->  new sync
 Dr. Kivo   old sync  ->  new sync
 Shelvorn   old sync  ->  new sync
 Dale       new sync since Nov 1

options.label: A. Turn it on for every bot
options.does: Switches the four other bots to the new sync.
options.risk: If it fails, bots get no mail until it is turned off.
options.undo: Turn it off; the old sync takes over within a minute.

options.label: B. One more day on Dale only
options.does: Keeps the test on Dale's mailbox.

card.pick_why: A full day on Dale showed no errors, and turning it off is quick.
card.skip: If no answer by due: we keep the test on Dale only.

fixtures.fixture: F-4 card whose Page has a file
expect: Evidence heading with 'See all on Page' at its right; it opens PG-1 Mission control in the Page viewer (4.3, 9).
Three tiles in order Page PG-1 (a link), Artifact AR-1, Mail MT-101.

card.title: Add the Search test results to Mission control?
card.about: Mission control is the quarterdeck Page the bots keep live. This adds a panel with the latest Search test run.
card.context:
Dr. Kivo's test log has the numbers.
The panel would sit beside the Queue panel.

options.label: A. Add the panel
options.does: Adds a Search tests panel to Mission control.
options.risk: One more panel on the Page.

options.label: B. Keep the Page as it is
options.risk: The numbers stay in the log only.

card.pick_why: The bots already open Mission control first; the numbers belong there.
card.skip: If no answer by due: we keep the Page as it is.

fixtures.fixture: F-5 card with saved version records
expect: The fold reads Earlier versions with 2 earlier versions and a change trail of 2 changes (4.7).
Version 1 shows its own options, pick A, and his answer to it: 'You answered: B. Friday 5 PM' with his note, as history only.
The waiting card (version 3) shows no answer; Send C is selected.

card.title: When should the weekly export go out?
card.about: The export sheet goes to the team once a week. This sets the day and time.
card.context:
You asked for Tuesday, so C is new and is the pick.
Monday mornings are already busy.
card.ascii:
Weekly export, when it goes out
 ------------------------------------------
 Mon   Tue   Wed   Thu   Fri
  A     C                 B
 8 AM  8 AM             5 PM

options.label: A. Monday 8 AM
options.does: The export goes out every Monday at 8 AM.
options.risk: It lands with the Monday mail.

options.label: B. Friday 5 PM
options.does: The export goes out every Friday at 5 PM.

options.label: C. Tuesday 8 AM
options.does: The export goes out every Tuesday at 8 AM.

card.pick_why: Tuesday morning misses the Monday rush and is still early in the week.
card.skip: If no answer by due: the first export goes out Tuesday at 8 AM.

edits.change: Added Tuesday 8 AM as C and made it the pick.
